sources.licenseNote: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Used to select the most notable people per birth century from 5000 BCE, every mathematician with HPI ≥ 70, Thales, Pythagoras, Hipparchus and Eratosthenes, and to rank the presidents of Brazil; the generated timeline tiles are shared under the same licence.
